summary: BUUU Group Limited (a BVI company filing on Form 6-K) announced on September 3, 2026 a definitive agreement to acquire a 60% equity interest in Brightray Science Inc., a provider of prefabricated modular data center solutions. Brightray will become a consolidated subsidiary upon completion, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals. Concurrently, BUUU entered into private placement subscription agreements to sell units at $10.00 per unit, each consisting of one Class A share and one-half warrant (exercise price $10.00, exercisable through September 2, 2027, cash-only). Gross proceeds expected to exceed $60 million, intended to fund Brightray's expansion. What to watch: regulatory approval timeline and deal completion risk.
